content: In comma-decimal locales (ru-RU among them), Excel opening a CSV interprets dot-decimal values matching day.month patterns as dates: '21.5' becomes 21 May, '3.12' becomes 3 Dec. Confirmed by multiple independent community sources (StackOverflow 77532621, Reddit r/excel, Datawrapper Academy, UiPath forum). Workarounds: comma-decimal in the file (RU-first), Power Query import, text-typed columns, or regional-settings change. Directly relevant to any fractional CSV column (screen diagonal 21.5/23.8).
